description: 32 additional atomic organ-related passages selected from five priority lectures; overlapping thematic coverage with the earlier 12-record pilot is intentional until canonical reconciliation.
limitations: Selected-passage checks, not exhaustive whole-lecture audits
Original German and translation collation pending
Historical medical claims do not support present-day treatment decisions

records.paraphrase: Steiner recommends studying digestion, heart and lungs, kidney and nerve-sense relationships, then liver, gall and spleen as an integrated physiology.
